title: Add changeset for patch release
body:
Adds a changeset to trigger a patch release for all fixed-group packages (3.0.6 → 3.0.7).

- **`.changeset/patch-release.md`** — Patch bump for `@objectstack/spec` (propagates to all 20+ packages via fixed versioning)
- **`ROADMAP.md`** — Fix stale version reference: `v3.0.2` → `v3.0.6`
